projects.description: Smart Garden IoT System utilizes an ESP32 integrated with various sensors and relays to monitor and control environmental conditions. The system features a Spring Boot and Angular stack, utilizing MQTT for real‑time data transmission, Influx DB for timeseries storage via Telegraf, and Grafana for visualization. It also incorporates Home Assistant for automation, Docker Compose for containerized deployment, and basic AI models to provide environmental insights and predictions.
projects.name: Smart Garden IoT System

projects.description: Developed a real‑time chat application using Spring Boot (backend) and Angular (frontend), enabling seamless messaging through a responsive chat interface and RESTful APIs. The system also integrates AI features to enhance user interaction and provide intelligent responses.
projects.name: Real‑time Chat Application

projects.description: Implemented custom HTTP communication over TCP sockets using C++. Developed low‑level client‑server networking logic to facilitate raw data exchange and demonstrate a foundational understanding of network protocols.
projects.name: HTTP over Sockets (C++)

projects.description: Deployed a comprehensive Wazuh SIEM environment to perform security monitoring and log analysis. Configured agents, manager, and integrated firewall, IDS/IPS, and WAF components.
projects.name: Wazuh Security System
